---
title: "Year-over-year CPI and Brent oil changes"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "scales", "readr", "readxl",
  "httr2", "imf.data"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(httr2)
library(imf.data)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
fetch_mospi_page <- function(page) {
  response <- httr2::request("https://api.mospi.gov.in/api/cpi/getCPIIndex") |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      base_year = "2012",
      series = "Current",
      year = paste(2014:2025, collapse = ","),
      month_code = paste(1:12, collapse = ","),
      state_code = "99",
      sector_code = "3",
      group_code = "1,5",
      subgroup_code = "1.99,5.99",
      Format = "JSON",
      limit = "200",
      page = as.character(page)
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  httr2::resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)$data
}

mospi_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(1:2, fetch_mospi_page))
month_names <- c(
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"
)

india_cpi <- mospi_raw |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, match(month, month_names))),
    country = "India",
    component = case_when(
      group == "Food and Beverages" ~ "Food CPI (MoSPI)",
      group == "Fuel and Light" ~ "Energy CPI proxy (MoSPI Fuel and Light)"
    ),
    index = as.numeric(index)
  ) |>
  select(date, country, component, index)

saudi_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  "https://datapulseactive.com/data/gastat/cpi_region_monthly.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

saudi_cpi <- saudi_raw |>
  filter(
    geo == "KSA",
    activity_code %in% c("coicop_01", "coicop_04"),
    metric == "cpi_index"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(date, "-01")),
    country = "Saudi Arabia",
    component = case_when(
      activity_code == "coicop_01" ~ "Food CPI (GASTAT)",
      activity_code == "coicop_04" ~ "Energy-related CPI proxy (GASTAT COICOP 04)"
    ),
    index = as.numeric(value)
  ) |>
  select(date, country, component, index)

imf_raw <- imf.data::get_data(
  "CPI",
  filters = list(
    COUNTRY = c("IND", "SAU"),
    INDEX_TYPE = "CPI",
    COICOP_1999 = "_T",
    TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION = "IX",
    FREQUENCY = "M"
  ),
  start_period = "2024-01",
  end_period = "2026-11"
)

imf_headline <- imf_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(OBS_VALUE)) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(
      substr(TIME_PERIOD, 1, 4), "-", substr(TIME_PERIOD, 7, 8), "-01"
    )),
    country = recode(COUNTRY, IND = "India", SAU = "Saudi Arabia"),
    component = "All-items CPI (IMF)",
    index = as.numeric(OBS_VALUE)
  ) |>
  select(date, country, component, index)

brent <- local({
  workbook <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  on.exit(unlink(workbook), add = TRUE)

  download.file(
    "https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/74e8be41ceb20fa0da750cda2f6b9e4e-0050012026/related/CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx",
    workbook,
    mode = "wb",
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  readxl::read_excel(
    workbook,
    sheet = "Monthly Prices",
    range = "A7:B900",
    col_names = FALSE,
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  ) |>
    setNames(c("period", "brent_usd_bbl")) |>
    mutate(
      brent_usd_bbl = as.numeric(brent_usd_bbl),
      date = as.Date(paste0(
        substr(period, 1, 4), "-", substr(period, 6, 7), "-01"
      ))
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(brent_usd_bbl)) |>
    select(date, brent_usd_bbl)
})

cpi_index <- bind_rows(india_cpi, saudi_cpi, imf_headline) |>
  arrange(country, component, date)

cpi_yoy <- cpi_index |>
  group_by(country, component) |>
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(yoy_pct = 100 * (index / lag(index, 12) - 1)) |>
  ungroup()

brent_yoy <- brent |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(brent_yoy_pct = 100 * (brent_usd_bbl / lag(brent_usd_bbl, 12) - 1))

line_data <- cpi_yoy |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("2025-01-01")) |>
  mutate(series = paste(country, component, sep = " — ")) |>
  select(country, date, series, yoy_pct) |>
  bind_rows(
    brent_yoy |>
      filter(date >= as.Date("2025-01-01")) |>
      crossing(country = c("India", "Saudi Arabia")) |>
      transmute(
        country,
        date,
        series = "Brent crude oil (World Bank)",
        yoy_pct = brent_yoy_pct
      )
  )

energy_yoy <- cpi_yoy |>
  filter(component %in% c(
    "Energy CPI proxy (MoSPI Fuel and Light)",
    "Energy-related CPI proxy (GASTAT COICOP 04)"
  )) |>
  transmute(country, date, energy_yoy_pct = yoy_pct)

regression_data <- energy_yoy |>
  inner_join(
    brent_yoy |> select(date, brent_yoy_pct),
    by = "date"
  ) |>
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2015-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2025-12-01"),
    !is.na(energy_yoy_pct),
    !is.na(brent_yoy_pct)
  )

india_model <- lm(
  energy_yoy_pct ~ brent_yoy_pct,
  data = filter(regression_data, country == "India")
)

saudi_model <- lm(
  energy_yoy_pct ~ brent_yoy_pct,
  data = filter(regression_data, country == "Saudi Arabia")
)
```

```{r yoy-cpi-brent, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
ggplot(line_data, aes(x = date, y = yoy_pct, color = series)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~country, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    limits = as.Date(c("2025-01-01", "2026-11-01"))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-over-year CPI and Brent oil price changes",
    subtitle = "Monthly observations from January 2025 to the latest available month",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Change from the same month one year earlier",
    color = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "CPI components: MoSPI (India) and GASTAT via DataPulse (Saudi Arabia);",
      "headline CPI: IMF; Brent: World Bank Pink Sheet."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r saudi-regression, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  filter(regression_data, country == "Saudi Arabia"),
  aes(x = brent_yoy_pct, y = energy_yoy_pct)
) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "#D55E00", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Saudi Arabia: energy-related CPI and Brent changes",
    subtitle = paste0("OLS fit, January 2015–December 2025; n = ", nobs(saudi_model)),
    x = "Brent price change, year over year (%)",
    y = "Energy-related CPI change, year over year (%)",
    caption = "CPI series: GASTAT COICOP 04, housing/water/electricity/gas and other fuels."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
```

```{r india-regression, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  filter(regression_data, country == "India"),
  aes(x = brent_yoy_pct, y = energy_yoy_pct)
) +
  geom_point(color = "#6A3D9A", alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "#E69F00", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "India: fuel-and-light CPI and Brent changes",
    subtitle = paste0("OLS fit, January 2015–December 2025; n = ", nobs(india_model)),
    x = "Brent price change, year over year (%)",
    y = "Fuel-and-light CPI change, year over year (%)",
    caption = "CPI series: MoSPI Fuel and Light group, 2012 base."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
```
